units.source_text: 我躺在你身边的时候，不曾梦见过你。

en.t: When I lay beside you, I never dreamed of you.

units.source_text: 同你分手以后，反而几乎每晚都梦见被你拥抱。

en.t: After parting from you, on the contrary, I dreamed almost every night that you were holding me.
As soon as I fell asleep, I began to cry.

units.source_text: 这样，早晨醒来，不胜悲戚。

en.t: And so, when I woke in the morning, I was overwhelmed with sorrow.

units.source_text: 这就是我晚上一入睡便眼泪汪汪的原因，同昔日高兴时的情形正好相反。

en.t: This is why my eyes filled with tears as soon as I fell asleep at night, the exact opposite of how it had been in happier days.
